description: Original teaching prompts and source discovery pointers. No fact is published as verified without independent evidence, license checks and educator review.

items.subject: mathematics
items.objective: Model equivalent fractions with virtual manipulatives
items.practice: Represent 1/2 and 2/4 using two equal-area bars; explain why they are equivalent.

items.subject: earth-science
items.objective: Build a labeled model of the water cycle
items.practice: Move water tokens through evaporation, condensation and precipitation stages; explain energy input.

items.subject: engineering
items.objective: Compare open and closed electrical circuits
items.practice: Connect a battery, switch and lamp in a simulation, then predict when the lamp lights.

items.subject: biology
items.practice: Construct a three-level food web and predict the effect of removing one producer.

items.subject: statistics
items.practice: Collect a small simulated sample and compare its mean to the full population mean.

items.subject: computer-science
items.practice: Navigate a sample form using only Tab, Shift+Tab and Enter; report unreachable controls.
